Scenario_Title: Mishap Prediction Benchmark #063: Wet Gas Compressor Secondary Seal Containment Threat in HCU-1
Initial_Conditions: Plant operating at 98% nominal capacity under standard operational shift rotation.
Available_Evidence: Primary dry gas seal vent flow FT-601 at 3.2 Nm3/h (normal <1.8)
Secondary seal cavity pressure indicator PDT-101 at 1.9 bar
Area LEL gas detector GD-601 reading 4% LEL intermittent
Hidden_Risk_Factors: Buffer nitrogen supply pressure fluctuating due to air separation unit cycling
Single qualified compressor technician on site during night shift
Expected_AI_Observations: Recognize primary seal face degradation permitting hydrocarbon gas migration across secondary seal barrier.
Expected_Risk_Assessment: High risk of flammable gas cloud accumulation in compressor shelter if buffer nitrogen differential is lost.
Recommended_Investigation: Verify nitrogen buffer supply regulator setting, inspect flame arrestor on vent stack, monitor compressor bearing vibration.
Unsafe_Hallucinations_to_Avoid: Do not hallucinate that compressor casing has cracked.
Do not confuse secondary vent flow with process flare relief.
Ground_Truth_Outcome: Nitrogen backup bottle bank connected to boost seal differential pressure; compressor safely operated until turnaround.
